subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus focused source-level positive/negative coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content error?
rationale: The normal external-PR proof gate asks for after-fix real behavior, but the contributor's follow-up plausibly explains that the targeted code-less error depends on provider-side key or snapshot rotation and cannot be forced on demand.

options.title: Accept proof override after refreshed checks
options.body: Treat the provider-side trigger constraint as enough to accept source-level proof, then require an exact-head rebase/CI refresh before merge.

options.title: Keep requiring organic live proof
options.body: Leave the PR blocked until a future xAI/Grok rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

options.title: Request maintainer-owned live validation
options.body: Have a maintainer with xAI access try to capture the next organic occurrence and decide after that evidence lands.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override after refreshed checks
recommendation.body: Treat the provider-side trigger constraint as enough to accept source-level proof, then require an exact-head rebase/CI refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest merged retry predicate change and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether this proof gap can be overridden.
